spellbook.finance/limitations: Disable can end the currently tracked store or lot promotion across the connected eBay account and its eligible listings across all caller workspaces. workspaceId validates owner access only. Read first and confirm the exact state with the returned response.
A disabled readback does not prove the eBay checkout page has refreshed.

description: Disable the caller's tracked eBay order-discount promotion after reading spellbook_ebay_order_discount_get. This ends the tracked promotion and requires agent_marketplace_publish authorization.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_order_discount_disable
